purpose: One explicit delegated engineering/verification task per registered agent role. Unconnected or non-persistent roles may be assigned or blocked, while runtime execution proof remains false until attributable lifecycle evidence exists.

execution_proof_policy.rule: A task is not marked runtime-proven unless attributable lifecycle evidence exists for the agent and task.
execution_proof_policy.enforcement: CI must fail closed if any registered agent lacks a task or any runtime-proof claim lacks lifecycle evidence.

operating_authority.user_authorized_scope: maximum practical engineering, research, testing, repository remediation, and deployment preparation within actual connected-tool/provider permissions
permitted_without_per_task_confirmation: inspect relevant source and CI evidence
create isolated branches and draft pull requests
fix or replace defective components with justified, testable changes
run isolated tests and regression suites where an execution environment is available
research deployment/provider integrations and prepare configuration
add newly discovered defects to the shared backlog and route them to an owner
boundaries: external agents do not receive capital authority or permission to change LIVE_LOCK to force release
production secrets must remain in an approved secret store with least privilege; do not print secrets or place them in source, issues, task payloads, or chat
platform-level production deployment, secret access, device enrollment, and provider authentication require actual authorized credentials and platform capability
do not claim persistent runtime or completed work without attributable evidence
merge, deployment, or release completion must be reported only after the actual platform action and verification
operating_authority.shared_backlog_rule: Every agent must inspect config/agent_remediation_backlog.json, execute its owned workstreams, and add any newly discovered blocker/defect to the same backlog through an attributable change.
operating_authority.source_of_truth: one canonical AURELIA system, one capital plane, one release authority, one evidence lineage
